45939841.name: Twister
45939841.desc: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

27174286.name: Return from the Different Dimension
27174286.desc: Pay half your Life Points; Special Summon as many of your banished monsters as possible. During the End Phase, banish all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.

41006930.name: Strike Ninja
41006930.desc: (Quick Effect): You can banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; banish this face-up card until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Strike Ninja" once per turn.

81866673.name: Destiny HERO - Dasher
81866673.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other monster; this card gains 1000 ATK until the End Phase. If this card attacks, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. 213326.name: E - Emergency Call
213326.desc: Add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

5318639.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
5318639.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

87910978.name: Brain Control
87910978.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

98494543.name: Magical Stone Excavation
98494543.desc: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

31423101.name: Divine Sword - Phoenix Blade
31423101.desc: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 300 ATK. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can banish 2 Warrior monsters from your GY; add this card to your hand.

19613556.name: Heavy Storm
19613556.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

23557835.name: Dimension Fusion
23557835.desc: Pay 2000 Life Points. Both players Special Summon as many of their removed from play monsters as possible.

51452091.name: Royal Decree
51452091.desc: Negate all other Trap effects on the field.

32807846.name: Reinforcement of the Army
32807846.desc: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand.

43040603.name: Monster Gate
43040603.desc: Tribute 1 monster; excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set. Special Summon it, also send the other excavated cards to the GY.

58577036.name: Reasoning
58577036.desc: Your opponent declares a monster Level from 1 to 12. Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, then, if that monster is the same Level as the one declared by your opponent, send all excavated cards to the GY. If not, Special Summon the excavated monster, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

72892473.name: Card Destruction
72892473.desc: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws the same number of cards they discarded.

40044918.name: Elemental HERO Stratos
40044918.desc:
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Destroy Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "HERO" monsters you control, except this card.
● Add 1 "HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

83965310.name: Destiny HERO - Plasma
83965310.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters. Negate the effects of face-up monsters while your opponent controls them. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). Gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect.

13093792.name: Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude
13093792.desc: Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Normal Spell, send it to the GY, otherwise place it on the bottom of your Deck. During the Main Phase of your next turn, you can activate the effect of that Spell in your GY (even if you no longer control this face-up card).

40737112.name: Dark Magician of Chaos
40737112.desc: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos" once per turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.
